category.title: Chest
category.intro: Push-up-based programmes that work the chest, front shoulders and triceps. You progress step by step from the wall to the full push-up, and from there to harder variations.
science: Push-ups done with challenging enough sets can give muscle and strength gains close to the bench press (a small 8-week study).
The order: wall → incline → kneeling → full push-up. Move to the next step once you can do 12–15 clean reps comfortably.
A narrow hand position and diamond push-ups tend to work the chest and triceps more; the effect of hand width isn't fully consistent between studies.
Fewer correct reps beat many sloppy ones: bend your elbows to at least 90 degrees and keep your body straight.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Up
exercises.setup: Stand an arm's length from a wall. Put your hands on the wall at shoulder height and shoulder-width apart.
steps: Bend your elbows to bring your chest towards the wall.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Push with your palms to return to the start.
exercises.tip: The further your feet are from the wall, the harder the move.
exercises.mistake: Don't stick your hips out; let your body move as one line.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.setup: Put your hands shoulder-width apart on the edge of a sturdy chair, sofa or step; feet back.
steps: Lower your chest towards the edge; elbows at a 45-degree angle to your body.
Stop when your chest nears the edge.
Push back up to straighten your arms.
exercises.tip: The lower the surface, the harder the move.
exercises.mistake: Don't use a chair that could slide; choose a fixed surface braced against a wall.

exercises.name: Kneeling Push-Up
exercises.setup: Hands slightly wider than your shoulders, knees on the floor, feet in the air. Form a straight line from your head to your knees.
steps: Bend your elbows to bring your chest towards the floor.
Stop when your chest is a fist's height from the floor.
Push back up to straighten your arms.
exercises.tip: Move to the full push-up once you can do 20 clean reps comfortably.
exercises.mistake: Don't go down by just dipping your head; lower your whole body together.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.target: Chest, front shoulders, triceps and core
exercises.setup: Hands slightly wider than your shoulders, arms straight, on your toes. A straight line from your head to your heels.
steps: Lower your chest to the floor with your elbows at about 45 degrees to your body.
Stop when your elbows are bent at least 90 degrees.
Push the floor away to straighten your arms.
exercises.tip: Gently squeeze your belly and glutes; keep your body stiff like a plank.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your hips drop or rise; don't flare your elbows straight out.

exercises.name: Wide Push-Up
exercises.setup: Push-up position, but with your hands about one and a half times shoulder-width apart.
steps: Lower your chest down between your hands.
Stop where you feel a stretch in your chest.
Push back up.
exercises.tip: Don't place your hands too wide; if you feel pressure in your shoulder, narrow your grip.
exercises.mistake: Don't strain your shoulders by flaring your elbows straight out.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.setup: Push-up position; bring your hands together under your chest so your thumbs and index fingers form a diamond.
steps: Keeping your elbows close to your body, lower your chest towards your hands.
Stop when your chest nears your hands.
Push back up.
exercises.tip: If it's too hard, do it with your knees on the floor.
exercises.mistake: Don't flare your elbows; let them bend backwards, close to your body.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
exercises.setup: Put your feet on a sturdy chair or step, hands on the floor shoulder-width apart.
steps: Keeping your body straight, lower your chest to the floor.
Stop when your elbows pass 90 degrees.
Push back up.
exercises.tip: The higher your feet, the harder it gets; start with a low step.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your lower back sag; keep your glutes tight.

exercises.name: Negative Push-Up
exercises.setup: Start in a push-up position: arms straight, body in a straight line.
steps: Lower very slowly over 4 seconds.
When your chest nears the floor, put your knees down.
Push up with the help of your knees and get back into the full position.
exercises.tip: If you can't do a full push-up yet, this is the best bridge: the lowering is the part that works the muscle most.
exercises.mistake: Don't rush the lowering; the real work is in the slow descent.

exercises.name: Push-Up Hold
exercises.setup: Get into a push-up position and lower halfway; elbows at about 90 degrees.
steps: Stay at this height.
Body straight, belly tight.
Keep breathing and hold until the time is up.
exercises.tip: If it's too hard, hold with your knees on the floor.

exercises.name: Chair Dips
exercises.setup: Stand in front of a sturdy chair placed against a wall. Put your hands behind you on the edge of the chair, knees bent, feet on the floor.
steps: Bend your elbows backwards and lower your hips.
Stop when your elbows reach 90 degrees.
Push up with your palms.
exercises.tip: The further you extend your legs, the harder the move.
exercises.mistake: Don't hunch your shoulders towards your ears; if your shoulder hurts, go down less.

exercises.name: Palm Press
exercises.setup: Stand tall. Press your palms together in front of your chest, elbows out to the sides.
steps: Press your palms together as hard as you can.
Feel the contraction in your chest and hold.
Relax and press again.
exercises.tip: Don't forget to breathe out while pressing.

exercises.name: Plyo Push-Up
exercises.setup: Push-up position: arms straight, body in a straight line.
steps: Lower with control.
Push the floor away fast; let your hands leave the floor for a moment.
Land softly with your elbows slightly bent and start again.
exercises.tip: Only try it if clean push-ups feel easy; if it's too hard, do it with your knees on the floor.
exercises.mistake: Don't land with locked arms; keep the landing soft to protect your wrists.

exercises.name: Spiderman Push-Up
exercises.setup: Push-up position: arms straight, body in a straight line.
steps: As you lower, bring your right knee out to the side towards your right elbow.
Take your leg back as you push up.
Use the left knee on the next rep; keep alternating.
exercises.tip: It's fine if your knee doesn't touch your elbow; keep your body straight.
exercises.mistake: Don't lift your hips when bringing your knee in.
